Showcase.title: Welcome, I am Abdulrahman Ismael
Showcase.brief: I build complete digital products across the full stack — from polished frontends in React, Next.js, and Angular, to robust backends with Node.js and Express, cross-platform mobile apps with React Native, and database systems with SQL, MySQL, and Microsoft SQL Server. Clean architecture, high performance, and maintainable code — every layer crafted with purpose.

About.title: About Me
About.subTitle: Get to know me further
About.desc: Software Engineer with hands-on experience delivering full-stack solutions across production environments. I build responsive and scalable frontends with React.js, Next.js, and Angular; backend services with Node.js, Express.js, and EJS templating; cross-platform mobile apps with React Native; and work with database systems including SQL, MySQL, and Microsoft SQL Server. I focus on clean, maintainable architecture, performance optimization, SEO, and accessibility — and I thrive in collaborative environments seeking new challenges in growing teams.
